t: The Site Willstrop work socks deliver comfort and durability for all-day wear across any working environment. Made from a polycotton blend of 80% cotton, 16% polyester, 3% polyamide and 1% elastane. Features knitted cuffs offering secure support and prevent slipping inside footwear, whilst the robust construction withstands regular washing and demanding conditions. Suitable for all footwear types from safety boots to trainers, this five-pair pack ensures you always have clean, comfortable socks available, with machine washable convenience for easy maintenance.
